top_choice_rationale: P001 (Autor, Dorn, Hanson; B036) rests on transparent local-labour-market designs that have been re-analysed with alternative exposure measures, inference and samples for about a decade. The sign and local concentration of the adjustment costs survived in qualified form, while magnitudes were revised. Attribution is the tightest on the slate because the core empirical programme is jointly authored by the three. The citation should rest on exposure and adjustment evidence, state no effect size, and say it is not a ruling on the origin of the task framework. Reservations remain about shift-share identification, long-run persistence, the uncredited Katz and task lineage, and overlap with recent prizes. I judge on the evidence, not on the count of supporters. P002 (Helpman, Melitz) is a mature, cleanly credited mechanism, but its welfare claims depend on model structure and the priority question involving Bernard, Eaton, Jensen and Kortum is unresolved. It is therefore second. No award (P000) is last because P001 and P002 each rest on substantial, well-tested work.
